latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of bo-faq-bot: a tool for building and querying a FAQ knowledge base from markdown files.

- Create, import, and manage FAQs with simple script commands.
- Fuzzy search matches user questions to the best FAQ answers with confidence scoring.
- Supports importing from markdown, exporting to markdown or JSON, and listing/stats of FAQs.
- Designed for integration with Feishu (Lark/飞书) business bots.
